title: Unitarian
summary: UNITA'RIAN, noun [Latin unitus, unus.] One who denies the doctrine of the trinity, and ascribes divinity to God the Father only. The Arian and Socinian are both comprehended in the term unitarian UNIT

inlines.v: UNITA'RIAN, noun [Latin unitus, unus.] One who denies the doctrine of the trinity, and ascribes divinity to God the Father only. The Arian and Socinian are both comprehended in the term unitarian UNITA'RIAN, adjective Pertaining to Unitarians, or to the doctrine of the unity of the Godhead.
